sam_procurement: FYI Zenith notified partial RMA shipment: 48 H100 units delayed in FRA customs. AWB 1Z999AA10123456784. They propose splitting: air 24 units now, sea backfill rest. Any objections? Need staging plan.

matt_zenith: Confirming. Customs flagged missing ECCN on commercial invoice. We've refiled, but clearance may add 48-72h. Air option + expedite charge ~€8k.

zoe_ops: Can we accept 24 air? Where would they land? FRA -> our AMS DC? @eng_infra_bot can we spare 24 slots for immediate staging + burn-in?

eng_infra_bot: Quick check: current free GPU slots across regions: us-west-2:0, eu-west-1:18, eu-central-1:6. Suggest routing to eu-west-1 for capacity. Will reserve 24 if approved.

leah_hw: Thermal note: partial batch flagged for 'potential thermal paste reflow' on return units. Need depot inspection on arrival. Ops to prep repair bench.

mina_finance: If we take air expedite, what's total landed cost? +VAT? Zenith, can you break down: freight €8k, customs brokerage €1.2k, expedited handling €600? Also invoice correction ETA?

matt_zenith: Yes. Provisional breakdown: freight €8k, brokerage €1.1k, customs duty €0 (ECCN corrected), expedited handling €600. We can issue corrected invoice by EOD. Sea option ETA +10 days, no expedite fee.

sam_procurement: Decision time — tradeoffs: pay €9.7k to get 24 units in 2-3 days vs wait ~10 days for 48. We need 24 for upcoming benchmark runs. @zoe_ops, leah_hw, confirm reserve.

zoe_ops: :thumbsup: Reserve 24 to eu-west-1. We'll start burn-in and smoke tests immediately.

leah_hw: Preparing depot: set aside bench 3 & 4, need serial list and expected DOA rate check. Send serials asap.

sam_procurement: matt_zenith please push serial list and AWB copy to this thread + tracking link. Also we need RMA paperwork for returns flow (labeling + return SLA).

matt_zenith: Uploaded docs to vendor portal and pushed link: https://zenith-logistics.example/track/1Z999AA10123456784 — serials attached. Return labels will be issued upon customs clearance. RMA SLA 14 days after depot acceptance.

zoe_ops: Heads-up: if customs hold >72h we may ask for temporary loaners. Any inventory to lend? @sam_procurement

sam_procurement: We have 8 spare H100s in on-prem warm pool. Could loan 6-8 for critical runs. But that reduces buffer.

mina_finance: If we take air, log cost center to 'inference-provisioning-Q2'. Approving up to €10k.

eng_infra_bot: Reservation confirmed: 24 slots eu-west-1 reserved until 2024-06-05 23:59 UTC. Will auto-release if not checked-in.

leah_hw: Once serials arrive we'll prep QA checklist. Quick snippet for label scanner: `scan --expect h100 --verify-serial`

sam_procurement: OK proceeding with air split. matt_zenith please confirm shipment sent and share final invoice. Thanks all.
